clauses.why: The verse says the silver, gold and vessels were weighed by his hand, not that he himself weighed them.
clauses.english: was the one by whose hand the silver, the gold and the vessels were weighed in the house of God
clauses.ukr: був тим, на чию руку відважили срібло, золото та посуд у домі Бога
clauses.deu: war der, unter dessen Hand Silber, Gold und Gefäße im Haus Gottes gewogen wurden
clauses.spa: fue aquel por cuya mano fueron pesados la plata, el oro y los vasos en la casa de Dios

clauses.english: repaired two pieces of the wall
